protocol: Optimizer-only diagnostic with identical real cached SfM, seed, targets, and camera RNG. Cameras3/11 excluded from loss and surface-color inputs. Sparse geometry and sparse colors were previously constructed using all cached images; this is NOT an independent novel-view or task88 acceptance benchmark. No refinement, no preview, no duty cycling, and no native bake timing. Compare fixed-step image quality and complete raw parameter hashes.
